snippet.title: Do You Have a Moment to Talk About Our Lord and Savior Trailer - A PSX PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR CARDGAME
snippet.description:
As a missionary, you go to spread your message to a wicked man. He, however, forces you to play a card game with him.

A WORSTEVENT GAME
